Service Requirements The Contractor must provide printing services, including the following tasks: • Graphic design and creation of annual report content for various Embassy offices. • Graphic design and creation of brochures, information portfolios, folders, advertising publications, flyers, and similar materials for the Embassy's promotional events. • Printing and/or photocopying of documents, brochures, and portfolios in a professional manner, ensuring clear colors, photographs, text, and images for finished products. Preference will be given to contractors offering multiple printing methods, such as commercial, digital, press, and web-based printing. • Supplying stock images for publications, as needed. • Providing printing designs for requesting offices to review and confirm prior to production. The Contractor is responsible for installing, setting up, and delivering printed items to U.S. Embassy Hanoi events. • Material Requirements: The Contractor shall present several material options for the Embassy's selection prior to submitting a quote. Tarkvaraarendaja peab omama kogemust Drupali-põhiste veebilahenduste arendamisel või liidestamisel ning vähemalt ühe kaasaegse JavaScripti raamistikuga (nt React, Angular või Vue.js) töötamisel. Tarkvaraarendaja peab omama teadmisi ja praktilist kogemust WCAG 2.2 AA ligipääsetavusnõuete rakendamisel veebiarenduses. Testija: vastutab kvaliteedikontrolli ja testimise eest (võib olla kombineeritud disaineri või projektijuhi rolliga). Pakkuja peab pakkumises esitama meeskonnaliikmete nimed ja rollid ning iga rolli kohta CV Lisa 6 vormil. Meeskonnaliikmeid võib hankelepingu täitmise ajal vahetada, kuid sellest tuleb hankijat eelnevalt teavitada. Asendav meeskonnaliige peab vastama vähemalt samadele nõuetele, mis olid esitatud asendatavale liikmele. Kogu projektiga seotud suhtlus, dokumentatsioon ja aruandlus peavad toimuma eesti keeles. Lähtekoodi kommentaarid ja tehniline dokumentatsioon koostatakse inglise keeles. deliverables_scope.text: o empower and better resource the Centre to support Ireland’s collective national effort to reverse biodiversity loss and contribute to nature restoration. The primary role of the Centre is to contribute to building the knowledge base on biodiversity and track how it is changing in Ireland. It works to ensure that data and information on Ireland’s biodiversity is more freely available and accessible for use in research, conservation management and decision-making. The National Biodiversity Data Centre is a predominantly publicly funded entity, rather than a public sector body. The Centre formally became a registered charity in November 2025. Requirements This Request for Quotation (RFQ) is a below-threshold competitive procurement process for printing services conducted in line with the National Public Procurement Policy Framework and relevant OGP guidance for goods and services. Quotations are being sought from suitably qualified suppliers for a three-year contract for printing services. This RFQ is being issued to all interested suppliers via public notice. Proposal Submissions should contain information under the following headings: Price (based on a defined representative sample) Technical Capability & Print Quality Sector Understanding & Approach Service, Meetings & Account Management E

Corporate Plan & Digital Strategy This tender relates to the continued provision of a Digital Services Development platform to ensure continuity and expansion of the digital programme in the Contracting Authority. The Contracting Authority has a people-centred Corporate Plan in place underpinned by innovative digital and communications strategies. The Contracting Authority’s vision is “Vibrant and inclusive communities inspired by a progressive economic environment providing sustainable opportunities for everyone.” Digital has a key role to play in enabling and delivering this vision. Residents have an increasing expectation to be able to access the Contracting Authority’s services quickly and conveniently at times and in ways that suit them. Our ambition is for the vast majority of our stakeholders to access public information and services in the same seamless and effortless way that they access services from the best online commercial providers. Our key stakeholders include citizens, visitors, elected members, employees, businesses, voluntary and community organisations and community planning partners. A Framework Agreement constitutes a means of establishing overall terms and conditions in accordance with which, for a specified duration, individual contracts may or not be awarded. In the context of a single-party Framework Agreement, the successful framework member does not have to compete for each new contract. It is emphasised that a Framework Agreement constitutes no guarantee to purchase a specific quantity of supplies or services from a particular Economic Operator. Indeed, the Contracting Authority reserves the right to operate outside of the Framework Agreement at its discretion, particularly should it become apparent that doing so would offer greater value for money. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Framework Agreement approach has been adopted in order to leverage efficiencies and maximise cost savings over the duration of the framework.
